Once upon a time:
there was a bear who had a very strong arm. One day he decided to take a walk outside to play. As he stepped out of the door, he noticed a big tree with a swing. The bear was so excited! He wanted to try it out.
The bear grabbed onto the rope and started to swing. The bear felt so strong and happy. He wanted to be like the animals. But then he noticed something. The bear was not happy.
The bear asked the other animals, "Why are you swinging so much?" But the other bear ignored them. He said, "I'm too big for you to swing. I'm too small!"
The bear felt sad and went to find some help. He saw a little girl playing in the park. He felt sorry for her. He said, "Don't be so sad. I will help you." So he used his strong arm to lift the tree off the swing.
The girl smiled and thanked the bear. They became friends and played together on the swings. The bear was no longer sad and he was no longer lonely.
